newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-GILFORD, SINGH JOIN OPEN LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-GILFORD, SINGH JOIN OPEN LEADERS.

text.p: Britain's David Gilford and Vijay Singh of Fiji carded a belated 66 apiece on Saturday for a share of the four-way midway lead in the South African Open.
The pair had completed only nine holes of the Glendower course on Friday when play was halted for the day because of lightning.
"I'm playing as well as I've ever played," said Gilford. "I'm driving well and hitting my irons nice and close. I usually start the season well, I must just keep it going."
Singh put his low scoring down to a hot putter. "I could be driving the ball better but my putter is behaving itself nicely, apart from on the 18th where I missed a simple four-footer for birdie."
Gilford and Singh set out on the third round sharing the lead on nine-under-par 135 with South African Wayne Bradley and Denmark's Thomas Bjorn.
Veteran Irishman Eamonn Darcy stood just one shot behind after a fine 69.
